title: Children Playing Baseball at Family Picnic, 1954 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Danny, Dee, Rae, Gary, Vern, & Steve Family picnic - playing baseball July 25 1954 560
description: A candid 1954 black-and-white snapshot captures young children engaging in a game of baseball during a sunny family picnic. A mid-1950s automobile is parked along the edge of a grassy yard, framing the scene of mid-century American childhood leisure. The reverse of the photo features handwritten details identifying the children, the activity, and the date of July 25, 1954.
